subject: prd/workbench-ui
statement: Where a document is rendered, the reading room should offer hand-offs to the existing flows — starting the annotation loop on that document and opening its tracked reference — while itself performing no annotation and no write.
rationale: "interact" means reaching the flows that own interaction
fit_criterion: demo on a live doc: the hand-off starts the existing annotation flow (or presents its exact invocation) without the reviewer typing a path; a write-audit of the UI process across the demo shows zero repo writes
